activity: Read-only source/caller/failure-path review. Root edited CI during the audit; reviewer re-read those corrections. Only this external report was written. Public official metadata and archive bytes fetched; no binary installed or run, no Git write, cloud job, Docker, runner or billing change.

findings.trigger: Any setup, dependency, formatting or clippy failure before fresh E2E: always-upload included tracked prior e2e.json, browser screenshots and ci-e2e.log. Artifact could contain local green evidence for a failed current job.
findings.proof: git ls-files confirmed those upload paths are tracked; ci.sh uses set -e and E2E is last.
findings.smallest_correction: Clear only those runtime evidence paths immediately after checkout; retain committed historical evidence in Git.

findings.trigger: A RustSec vulnerability, prohibited dependency license or unapproved registry/git source can fail public just check while original CI never performs the Rust deny/audit gates.
findings.proof: Original ci.sh omitted cargo deny and cargo audit; justfile17-18 requires them.
findings.smallest_correction: Provision pinned existing dev tools and run cargo deny --locked check plus cargo audit --no-yanked; use online initialization on a fresh hosted cache.

findings.trigger: A browser assertion fails: E2E creates failure-diagnostic.json and failure-<actor>.png, but the original upload globs exclude both.
findings.smallest_correction: Include the two failure paths in the upload and initial freshness cleanup.

existing_policy_and_data.policy: deny.toml: advisories version2, explicit permissive license allowlist, private-workspace license exemption, duplicate versions warn, unknown registries/git deny. No new exception or policy is required.
existing_policy_and_data.dependency_data: Cargo.lock and registry package source/license data supplied by cargo fetch --locked; Bun frozen workspace lock remains unchanged.
existing_policy_and_data.advisories: Both use current https://github.com/RustSec/advisory-db, but deny defaults to $CARGO_HOME/advisory-dbs with URL-hashed subdirectory; audit defaults to ~/.cargo/advisory-db. Fresh runner cannot assume either local cache exists.
existing_policy_and_data.normal_online_mode: cargo deny --locked check and cargo audit --no-yanked initialize/refresh their own databases. Existing --offline / --no-fetch flags require explicit prior database population; do not weaken checks with --stale or ignores.
existing_policy_and_data.exact_offline_alternative: cargo deny fetch db can populate deny data first; audit needs its own fresh database initialization before --no-fetch. Using each online checker once is the smaller current CI path.
existing_policy_and_data.current_choice: Root uses official pinned prebuilt x86_64 musl archives with hardcoded SHA256 checks, explicit expected member paths, executable install and version print; no third-party installer action or runtime dependency added.

verified_portability.script_paths: CI run.py resets cwd/target dir to repository, platform launch chooses /usr/bin/google-chrome on Linux, startup negative probe intentionally uses temporary cwd/missing binary. No macOS-only call exists in the actual CI path.
verified_portability.timeouts: Job20 minutes; overall ci.sh wrapper900 seconds; E2E180 seconds; startup probe10 seconds; server startup15 seconds, fetch1 second; browser launch20 seconds; tool-download step5 minutes. Source limits exist; cold hosted elapsed time unmeasured.
verified_portability.failure_evidence_boundary: Hard timeout, runner termination or cleanup exceptions can prevent E2E report completion. Fresh initialization avoids uploading an old green result; newly generated CI logs remain the fallback. This audit did not inject those failures.
